title: Writers festival, Cornucopia and live music: your Sea to Sky weekend
description: What’s on in Whistler, Squamish, Pemberton and Britannia Beach this weekend: literary festival, food & drink, markets, live music, comedy and more.
intro: What’s on in Whistler, Squamish, Pemberton and Britannia Beach this weekend: literary festival, food & drink, markets, live music, comedy and more.

entries.name: Whistler Writers Festival
entries.venue: Fairmont Chateau Whistler, 4599 Chateau Blvd · Squamish Lil’wat Cultural Centre, 4584 Blackcomb Way
entries.blurb: 25th annual literary festival. Friday sessions: one-on-one editing sessions 3:30 PM, “Cultural & Spiritual Care: Healing through Stories” 5:30–6:45 PM, and “Characters on the Edge: Analyzing Psychological Thrillers” 8:00–10:00 PM.

entries.name: Cornucopia: Whistler’s Food & Drink Festival
entries.blurb: Whistler’s signature food & drink festival: tastings, culinary demos, winemaker dinners and drink seminars across the village.
badges: Prices vary · some dinners sold out

entries.name: Express Yourself Through Art
entries.blurb: Relaxed morning art session with Dr. Helma, music and colour, no skills needed, all supplies provided.

entries.name: Fairmont Friday at Mallard Lounge
entries.venue: Mallard Lounge, Fairmont Chateau Whistler, 4599 Chateau Blvd
entries.blurb: Weekly Friday tradition with handcrafted cocktails, live music and a shareable feature food menu.

entries.name: We Heart Local Art | Art Party
entries.venue: Maury Young Arts Centre, 4129 Village Stroll
entries.blurb: Arts Whistler celebrates the 16 local artists behind the “We Heart Local Art” exhibit, landscapes, wildlife and textiles.

entries.name: Benson @ Après Après: Fluid Fridays
entries.blurb: DJ Benson brings house beats and a high-energy set for a Welcome Week edition of Fluid Fridays.

entries.name: SEEK Bespoke Market
entries.venue: Railway Museum of BC, 39645 Government Rd
entries.blurb: Curated market with 100 creative brands, plus wreath-making and flow-writing workshops, constellation piercings, flash tattoos, intuitive readings and pop-up portraits. VIP shopping hour 4:00–5:00 PM.

entries.name: Sip & Savour: Experience Macau at Fergie’s Café
entries.blurb: A tasting experience through Macau’s Portuguese-Chinese fusion cuisine, widely considered the world’s first fusion food. Two seatings.

entries.name: Jon Bryant with J Aaron Cockburn
entries.blurb: Indie-rock/folk singer-songwriter with pedal steel, bass and drums; opener J Aaron Cockburn.

entries.name: Coastal Distortion Vol. 2
entries.blurb: Raw underground rock night headlined by Vancouver punk veteran I, Braineater, with Tides Will Turn, Shone and Zombie Roof.
warnings: Time unconfirmed: venue lists 9:00 PM, allevents lists 7:00 PM

entries.name: Colour Analysis at SEEK Bespoke Market
entries.venue: Railway Museum of BC, 39645 Government Rd
entries.blurb: Personalized one-on-one colour analysis consultation, running all three market days.

entries.name: Live Music @ Town Square: JR
entries.venue: Town Square Restaurant, 7439 Frontier St, Pemberton
entries.blurb: Weekly Friday-night live music series at Town Square.

entries.name: Whistler Writers Festival
entries.blurb: Day three of the literary festival: readings, panels and workshops, including “Glorious, Disrupting Dystopia” 1:45–3:00 PM.

entries.name: Cornucopia: Whistler’s Food & Drink Festival
entries.blurb: The food & drink festival continues, tastings, culinary demos, winemaker dinners and drink seminars.

entries.name: Sculpt & Sip x Cornucopia x Fort Berens
entries.venue: The Westin Resort & Spa Whistler, 4090 Whistler Way
entries.blurb: Guided stone-carving class with Fathom Stone Art. Pick a project and take home what you make. Tools and materials included, no experience needed.

entries.name: AGELESS Expo
entries.venue: Myrtle Philip Community School, 6195 Lorimer Rd
entries.blurb: Expo of resources and connections tailored for the 50+ crowd, presented by Pique Newsmagazine.

entries.name: Whistler Comedy Classic
entries.venue: Maury Young Arts Centre, 4335 Blackcomb Way
entries.blurb: Pro stand-up comedy night produced by Jokers Canada, with scheduled performers including Syd Bosel.

entries.name: SEEK Bespoke Market
entries.venue: Railway Museum of BC, 39645 Government Rd
entries.blurb: The 100-brand curated market continues, with workshops and experiences through the day.
warnings: Hours unconfirmed: organizer lists 10 AM–5 PM, allevents lists 10 AM–6 PM

entries.name: Squamish Farmers Winter Market
entries.venue: 37996 Cleveland Ave (corner of Victoria St & Cleveland Ave)
entries.blurb: Weekly winter market with fresh local farm produce, prepared foods and artisan products.

entries.name: Explore CapU Squamish: Fall Open House
entries.venue: Capilano University Squamish Campus, 3200 University Blvd
entries.blurb: Open house with program info, campus tours and student meet-and-greets.

entries.name: Sea to Sky Artisan Market
entries.blurb: Early-Christmas-gift shopping from artisans across the Sea to Sky corridor.

entries.name: Watercolour Painting Workshop: Bespoke Wellness
entries.venue: Railway Museum of BC, 39645 Government Rd (inside SEEK market)
entries.blurb: Guided winter-landscape watercolour workshop inside the SEEK Bespoke Market.

entries.name: Sound of Devotion ~ A Day Retreat
entries.blurb: Day retreat of sound vibration, mantra, story and grounding practice for the dark half of the year.

entries.name: Squamish United Coffee House: Catherine McInnes
entries.blurb: Afternoon of live music and stories.

entries.name: The Zummers LIVE!
entries.venue: Routes Eatery, Capilano University, 3200 University Blvd
entries.blurb: Live band night with food and local beer at the campus eatery.

entries.name: New Moon Sound Journey
entries.blurb: Meditative sound journey for the new moon: deep rest and inward connection.

entries.name: Dani Black, Drew Storey, Shane Terry
entries.blurb: Singer-songwriter night: Drew Storey (Langley) plus Dani Black and Shane Terry.

entries.name: Colour Analysis at SEEK Bespoke Market
entries.venue: Railway Museum of BC, 39645 Government Rd
entries.blurb: Personalized one-on-one colour analysis consultation.

entries.name: This Ain’t No Dog & Pony Show: Art Exhibition & Fundraiser
entries.blurb: Fundraiser celebrating 20 years of arts and culture in the Pemberton Valley, with a live silent auction of local treasures.
warnings: Time unconfirmed: source lists both 6:00–9:30 PM and 5:00–8:30 PM

entries.name: Whistler Writers Festival: closing day
entries.blurb: Closing day: “Being Forest: A Salish Stroll” 9:00–10:30 AM (meet in the lobby), then Sunday BookTalk and breakfast 11:00 AM–1:00 PM.

entries.name: Cornucopia: Whistler’s Food & Drink Festival
entries.blurb: The food & drink festival rolls on, tastings, demos and seminars across the village.

entries.name: Run & Restore: Hit & Go × Yogacara
entries.blurb: Casual community run paired with movement and recovery guidance from Yogacara’s Emily Kane.

entries.name: SEEK Bespoke Market: final day
entries.venue: Railway Museum of BC, 39645 Government Rd
entries.blurb: Final day of the 100-brand curated market, 10:00 AM–4:00 PM.

entries.name: Squamish Estuary Monthly Bird Count
entries.venue: Meet in the lobby of Howe Sound Inn & Brewing, 37801 Cleveland Ave
entries.blurb: Monthly citizen-science bird count in the Squamish Estuary: all levels welcome, binoculars optional, groups split into four.

entries.name: Sunday Night Football
entries.blurb: Full sound system and three projectors showing the 5 PM games.

entries.name: Colour Analysis at SEEK Bespoke Market
entries.venue: Railway Museum of BC, 39645 Government Rd
entries.blurb: Personalized one-on-one colour analysis consultation, final day.

entries.name: ORE & ORCAS: new exhibit at Britannia Mine Museum
entries.blurb: Temporary Terra Lab exhibit on Howe Sound’s recovering marine ecosystem, included with museum admission (underground train + BOOM! show).

notes: Confirm before you go. Times were researched on Nov 4, 2026 from the source pages linked above. Check the event pages directly before heading out, especially listings marked with time warnings.
Events without stated times were listed on their source calendars with no start time given; those marked “unconfirmed” had conflicting times across sources.
